_comment: V3 of the Salman Farsi / Just Ask Expo reel. IDENTICAL to 2026-08-14_salman-just-ask-expo-v2 except that P1 -- the opening hook take -- is DROPPED entirely. Everything else (the AI kinetic-multicam P2, all three P3 spans, every treatment, every keep range) is unchanged. v1 and v2 are finished and delivered; this is a separate folder and does not touch either.
_p1_removal_note: P1 was the hook: 'Oh, are you also stuck? But you are stuck with which course is suit for you? Then this event is for you' -- 5.80s on the old output timeline. input/P1.MOV and work/P1.transcript.json are deliberately LEFT IN PLACE (they cost nothing and document what was cut); it is this file's clips[] that decides what gets built, and P1 no longer appears in it. Consequences: (a) the reel now OPENS on P2, so everything from the old segment 1 onward shifts -5.80s and total content is 20.27s (was 26.07s); (b) segment indices shift down by one, which is why date_behind.py now writes seg_01 and cities_behind.py seg_02, and why content.json's zoom hit moved from clip 4 to clip 3; (c) the old P1->P2 cut at 5.80 no longer exists, so its wipe and its transition-whoosh cue are both gone. Every LOCAL timing inside the per-reel scripts is untouched -- all four surviving clips keep their exact v2 keep ranges.
_p2_note: P2 (input/P2.mp4) is an AI-generated restyle of the original P2 take: same speaker, same location, same spoken line ('One event, one afternoon, every answer'), but cut into rapid camera repositions (close-up -> wide walking shot) with kinetic supers ONE EVENT / ONE AFTERNOON / EVERY ANSWER already burned into the picture. Two consequences handled in content.json: the reel's own 2-word captions are suppressed across this segment (they would print the same three phrases a second time), and the EVERY ANSWER badge that used to sit on this line is dropped for the same reason.
_p2_spec_note: "sdr": true is REQUIRED on this clip and is not optional styling. P3 is genuine iPhone HDR (yuv420p10le, arib-std-b67, BT.2020) and takes build_base.py's HLG->SDR tone-map path; P2 is 8-bit yuv420p with ALL FOUR colour tags reading 'unknown', and zscale=t=linear errors outright on input with no transfer to convert from. The sdr path skips the tone-map and stamps bt709/tv via setparams instead. It is also 720x1280 @ 24fps against the reel's 1080x1920 @ 30 -- the pipeline upscales and retimes it, so it is softer than the surrounding takes. That is inherent to the supplied asset, not a pipeline setting. With P1 gone this clip is now the FIRST thing a viewer sees, so that softness is more exposed than it was in v2.
_p2_trim_note: keep [1.55, 5.92]: first word 'One' at 1.799 (0.25s of lead-in, and nothing is burned on screen before it), last word 'answer.' ends 5.679, trailing self-cue 'Okay' at 6.019 dropped. The 1.56s gap between 'afternoon,' (ends 3.419) and 'every' (starts 4.980) is DELIBERATELY kept -- it is not dead air, it is where the walking shot and the ONE AFTERNOON super play out. Trimming it would cut the baked animation in half.
_audio_note: Integrated speech loudness is -20.9 LUFS on P2 against -21.8 (P3), so there is no level jump at the cut. Still worth an ears pass for room-tone/codec character, since this segment's audio has been through an AI generation pass and P3 has not -- and it is now the reel's opening sound with nothing before it to set a reference.
_timing_note: Segment durations are 4.37 / 6.45 / 3.10 / 6.35 = 20.27s, so the segment openings are 0.00 / 4.37 / 10.82 / 13.92. That is exactly v2's set minus P1's 5.80s prefix.
